messages:
deploy-bot: FYI scheduling a canary unpin of runtime v3.0 in ap-southeast-1 tomorrow 2025-02-10T03:00Z. Will route 4% for 25m. Cmd: `deploybot unpin runtime v3.0 --canary ap-southeast-1 --pct 4 --dur 25m`
Rina: Heads-up: v3.0 tweaks the KV eviction order for small-batch encoder calls. Impacts batched embeddings only, but seen in internal low-latency customers.
Carlos: Detection proposal: 1) embedding_cosine_shift > 0.015 over 10m, 2) p95 latency +75ms, 3) kv_eviction_errors > 5 in 5m. If any two hit -> canary pinback.
Maya: Also add an SDK-side guard: SDK-go <1.8 will log a warning when talking to runtime 3.0. We'll push a minor release that surfaces the header `X-Runtime-Version` to telemetry so we can correlate.
oncall-bot: I will page if embedding_cosine_shift or kv_eviction_errors thresholds exceeded. Will also create ephemeral runbook and pin to #eng-oncall.
Rina: Rollback policy: first attempt automatic canary pinback for 10m. If metrics persist, escalate to global pin and inform CS and SOC. Annotate rollback reason: `--annotation "embed_cosine_drift"`.
Carlos: Please run a `--dry-run` first and publish the plan to /var/deploybot/plans/2890011222.json so QE can review expected changes.
Maya: I'll run the long-input regression harness every 60s and paste sample diffs here if anything looks off. Also will bump debug logging for kv-indexer during the window.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Dry-run plan ready. Will post the final invocation 15m prior and tag @eng-oncall.
Rina: Operational note: delay if change-approval ticket not closed. Don't start until the CAB greenlight is in the ticket.
Carlos: If safe, ramp to 12% after 3h, then 30% after 12h. We'll not go global until telemetry is stable for 24h.
Maya: I'll prepare a short release-note blurb calling out the batched-embed caveat and recommended SDK versions. Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/drafts/v3.0-canary-unpin
Rina: Thanks all. Keep this thread live during the window. If we need to pin back, use `deploybot pin runtime v2.28 --force --annotation "auto-pin"` and file a postmortem.
